units.source_text: 忽然，从幽暗中窜出一团黑乎乎的东西。

en.t: Suddenly, a dark, blackish shape burst out from the gloom.

units.source_text: 一条相当大的狗，从没见过的狗，大口大口地喘着气。

en.t: It was a fairly large dog, a dog he had never seen before, panting in great heaving breaths.

units.source_text: 但那狗好像没有受过攻击训练，临到该露出牙齿时，它却傻乎乎地叫了一声。

en.t: But the dog seemed not to have been trained to attack; when the moment came to bare its teeth, it only gave a foolish bark.

units.source_text: 他赶紧挥了下手臂，系在绳索上的剪刀有了击中的反应，

en.t: He hurriedly swung his arm, and the scissors tied to the rope gave the feel of having struck something,

units.source_text: 只听那狗恨恨地叫了一声，重新融入黑暗之中。

en.t: then he heard the dog give a resentful yelp before melting back into the darkness.

units.source_text: 还好，只有裤子的下摆给咬开了。

en.t: Luckily, only the hem of his trousers had been bitten open.

units.source_text: 一个跟头，脚被捉住了，他倒下去一个鹞子翻身，爬起来，又跑开了。

en.t: He tumbled, his foot was caught, and as he fell he twisted over like a hawk, scrambled up, and ran off again.
